chapter_title_en: Tariel's Letter in Answer to his Beloved
chapter_expert_explanation_en: Resuming his narrative, Tariel recounts sending Nestan-Darejan the Khatavian veil and his letter of devotion.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
მივუწერე: “მზეო, შუქი შენი, შენგან მონაფენი,
გულსა მეცა, გამიცუდდეს სიჩაუქე სიალფენი;
ხელმან შენნი განვიცადენ სინატიფე-სიტურფენი,
და სულთა ნაცვლად სამსახურნი რადმცა ვითა გიმუქფენი?
stanzas.english_translation: "I wrote: 'O sun! thy ray beaming forth from thee struck my heart; my alertness and boldness are brought to nought; mad for thee, I have perceived thy beauty and loveliness; with what service can I pay thee in exchange for life?'
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 22 ('Tariel's Letter in Answer to his Beloved', Stanza 503; Wardrop Stanza 487): Part of the narrative sequence in which resuming his narrative, Tariel recounts sending Nestan-Darejan the Khatavian veil and his letter of devotion.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“მაშინ, ოდეს დამარჩინე, სულთა სრულად არ გამყარე,
აწ ჩემთვისცა ესე ჟამი მასვე ჟამსა დავადარე;
სამხრე შენი მომივიდა, შემოვიბი მკლავსა გარე,
და რომე მმართებს სიხარული, ეგზომიმცა რა ვიხარე!?
stanzas.english_translation: "'Then when thou didst make me to survive (and) sufferedst me not to be wholly sundered from life, now this time I compare with that time. I have received thine armlet; I have bound it round mine arm. How can I show my joy as much as is fitting?
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 22 ('Tariel's Letter in Answer to his Beloved', Stanza 504; Wardrop Stanza 488): Part of the narrative sequence in which resuming his narrative, Tariel recounts sending Nestan-Darejan the Khatavian veil and his letter of devotion.

stanzas.english_translation: "'Of a truth I offer thee, lo! the veil which thou demandest; also a cloak, of the same (stuff), the like of which thou wilt not find. Leave me not to faint, help me, succour me, come!' Whom can I entreat in this world save thee?'
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 22 ('Tariel's Letter in Answer to his Beloved', Stanza 505; Wardrop Stanza 489): Part of the narrative sequence in which resuming his narrative, Tariel recounts sending Nestan-Darejan the Khatavian veil and his letter of devotion.

stanzas.english_translation: "The maid arose and forsook me. I lay down and fell pleasantly asleep, but I shivered, I saw my beloved in my sleep; I awoke, I had her no more, life was a burden to me; thus I passed the night, I heard not her voice.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 22 ('Tariel's Letter in Answer to his Beloved', Stanza 506; Wardrop Stanza 490): Part of the narrative sequence in which resuming his narrative, Tariel recounts sending Nestan-Darejan the Khatavian veil and his letter of devotion.

key_maxim_ka: გველსა ხვრელით ამოიყვანს ენა ტკბილად მოუბარი
key_maxim_en: A sweetly speaking tongue brings a snake out from its lair.
